page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance provides 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the ecs.g5ne.2xlarge generally delivers entry-level to moderate performance. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests, such as stress-ng and Geekbench, place the instance in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show weak read-only performance for both small and large blocks, though large block write bandwidth reaches average levels. Cryptographic and compression tasks, including gzip and bzip3, also rank in the lower percentiles. However, the CPU demonstrates average performance in Passmark CPU and extended instruction tests, as well as average prompt processing and text generation speeds for small 135M parameter language models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g5ne.2xlarge offers a dedicated resource allocation without the premium cost of high-performance compute or memory-optimized hardware classes. Given its moderate processing capabilities and lack of local storage, it is best suited for general-purpose workloads that do not demand high computational throughput or extreme memory speeds. Appropriate applications include basic web serving, lightweight database operations, development environments, and small-scale background processing tasks.
